x: By Streatham Pat had moved into fourth place behind Roy Thorpe of Wakefield with the Belgrave Team about level with Surrey and Trowbridge. By Gatwick Pat was,clear of the field in third place some 10 minutes behind the leaders.

An overdose of glucose gave Roy Thorpe of Wakefield a brief spell in the lead but by 50 Kilos (4.33.50) Pat had once again gone ahead and from then on he moved steadily away to improve on his last year's record by some 2½ minutes.
